adhkar.subtitle: The complete Fortress of the Muslim: daily and occasional adhkar, each with its virtue, what it protects from, and its evidence
adhkar.searchPlaceholder: Search the dhikr texts (Arabic) or chapter names

adhkar.dailyReset: Counters reset automatically every day and are stored on your device only.
adhkar.arabicOnly: The dhikr texts and notes are in Arabic.
adhkar.noteHelp: A «virtue» is shown only when a hadith states it, with its evidence. Where no specific reward is reported we show «Sunnah» or «Meaning» without claiming any reward.
adhkar.credits: Dhikr texts and repetition counts come from Hisn al-Muslim via the Adhkar-json and azkar-db datasets; morning/evening adhkar and their takhrij come from Seen-Arabic (MIT). Every stated virtue is linked to its hadith in this site's hadith library; hadith numbering follows sunnah.com.
